commit.message:
Record the verdict on abd85896

Verdict: abd85896 helped: complex laps took 1.4 lap-hours per merge against 2.6, over 12 laps.

Pin Archon abd85896: holdouts fenced in the repository; the complex route runs dev's ship-block

Holdouts move into the project (`.factory/holdout/HOLDOUT.md`, committed so a team shares them)
behind a Claude Code hook the install registers in `.claude/settings.json`:
`.factory/hooks/holdout_fence.py` refuses every agent but the holdout-verifier and
holdout-writer subagents any call that would show it a scenario (naming the folder, a
recursive search that covers it, a git diff/log/show that would print one of its files, asked
of git first so nothing else is refused), refuses any agent's change to the fence itself, and
logs scenario text that reaches a tool result anyway to holdout-exposures.jsonl in the git
directory. `.ignore` keeps Grep and Glob out. `doctor` runs the registered hook on synthetic
calls and reports whether the fence holds and whether it is committed. Proven live in an
Archon run: a step's `cat` of the scenarios was refused; the inline verifier read them.

The pinned pack (Archon abd85896) runs holdouts only through those two inline agents, refuses
owner-only paths at the loop's merge gate (the factory now passes `protected_paths` to
archon-loop, and `.claude/settings.json` and `.ignore` join the default list), and takes the
complex route through dev's archon-ship-block. The manifest follows it: archon-holdouts and
archon-ship-block in; the forked ship, deliver, review, triage and lifecycle out, with the
state-label defaults they took. The schedule's default workflow is archon-loop.

DECISIONS.md starts the factory's decision log, which the mission-control dashboard reads.

Hypothesis: complex laps finish faster and are sent back less, now that delivery runs dev's rounds instead of the fork's script gates; no builder step reads a holdout.
Measure: on the mission-control factory, complex-route lap-hours per merge and send-backs per merge against North Star's 10/21-10/23 numbers, over at least 10 complex laps; holdout exposures stay at 0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

# Decisions

## 2026-10-24 Holdouts live in the repository, behind a hook
Decision: Holdout scenarios live in the repository.
Why: Builder steps read them.
Replaces: Holdout files kept outside the repository.
Version: abd85896

## 2026-10-24 The complex route runs dev's ship-block
Decision: Complex laps deliver through archon-ship-block.
Why: The fork's script gates sent back more work.
Replaces: The forked ship workflow.
Version: abd85896
